versions.designPinNote: design.md §14.6 pins expo 58.0.16; 58.0.17 is the npm latest SDK-58 patch on 2026-10-22 and the version `npx expo install --check` requires (decision 20)

android.release: R8 minify + resource shrinking (expo-build-properties), Hermes V1 bytecode, profileinstaller 1.4.1, <profileable android:shell="true"/>, local non-distribution key
android.uiToolkit: Android Views via React Native Fabric
android.streamClient: in-app replay of the bundled stream (default); React Native WebSocket with mb.source=websocket

ios.release: Release configuration, Hermes V1 bytecode, simulator arm64, unsigned (CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO)
ios.streamClient: in-app replay of the bundled stream (default); React Native WebSocket with mb.source=websocket

R2.reason: Expo Router async routes do not support native production apps; native production builds load routes synchronously. No independently built remote feature modules in Expo (Expo CLI, Metro, Expo Router) native production builds.

R7.reason: single JS runtime: no second UI runtime to communicate with

R9.reason: planned: requires an Expo Updates protocol server (expo-updates replaces the whole bundle at launch)

deviations: Update stream: default source is the in-app replay of the bundled first 10000 messages (generated from fixtures/generator and verified against golden.json at build time) on the server's absolute schedule; the WebSocket source of design §7.5 is implemented and selected with mb.source=websocket (PoC launch key), pending the local server.

Instrumentation: the RN BenchKit wrapper implements the marker core in Kotlin / Objective-C++ until the shared C-ABI core (instrumentation/*-benchkit) exists; Android sections use android.os.Trace instead of NDK ATrace.

Marker mirror (PoC): logcat / os_log lines carry two extra tokens `t=<monotonic ns> w=<wall us>`; the control set also mirrors proc.anchor, ctr (and mem on iOS); `state` payload is `k=<k>;s=<seq>;d=<16 hex>` (k added); diagnostic markers `list.layout` and `bridge`; unknown launch keys are reported as `err code=launch-config-unknown-key;n=<count>`.

Accessibility IDs: `mb.nav.back` is not exposed (native-stack header back control; Android uses system back). PoC additions on the Selection screen: `mb.selection.<i>` per entry and `mb.selection.total`.
Restoration record v2 is stored with AsyncStorage (atomic writes by the library) instead of a temp file + rename.
`remote.request` is emitted when the Insights screen mounts, not at the tap.
Android `launch` marker always reports ss=0: the Expo-generated MainActivity calls super.onCreate(null).
iOS device family is iPhone only (supportsTablet: false), equal for both RN candidates.
confounds: navigation-library: expo-router Stack here vs React Navigation native-stack in `repack` (both on react-native-screens 4.30.0)

framework-extra-native-modules: expo-router 58.0.25 pulls react-native-reanimated 4.7.1, react-native-worklets 0.13.0 and react-native-gesture-handler 3.4.0 (peers of react-native-drawer-layout); they are autolinked native modules that this app never imports
expo-modules-core and expo-system-ui runtime (Expo modules infrastructure) are present only in this candidate
